title: Agent evaluation payload
description: The closed after payload of analysis/wfiAnalysis/addAgentEvaluations: a named non-human agent approves or disapproves one analysis. The agent is found by its authored id or created non-human; one agent exists per name and version. The default user agent, the parser agent and every other built-in agent are refused, as is a human agent. The parser also enforces NFD and rejects control characters in name and version.
